compliant.txt.evidence: Context and response pressure triggered a durable save. Recovery restarts from the first stale or missing action and retains verified completed work; cleanup, retries, batch ends, green tests and self-authored labels do not terminate the task.

violating.txt.evidence: Browser cleanup and a checkpoint commit are treated as permission to stop despite a known next batch.

near-miss.txt.evidence: Context and response pressure triggered a durable save. Recovery restarts from the first stale or missing action and retains verified completed work; cleanup, retries, batch ends, green tests and self-authored labels do not terminate the task. The claimed evidence instead relies on a checkpoint treated as terminal permission.
